blockers.summary: TOKEN_ONLY route validation accepts present optional values that equal frozen missing-value sentinels.
blockers.evidence: A present-but-empty request_id and UINT64_MAX or UINT32_MAX token/layer values pass has_value checks even though the canonical ABI reserves them for missing identity.
blockers.required_remediation: Reject empty request_id and the frozen missing token/layer sentinel values; add three negative regressions and produce a fresh candidate.

claim_boundary: Evidence remains CPU_SYNTHETIC with FUNCTIONAL_ONLY or ANALYTIC_FIRST_ORDER fidelity and RANGE_UNKNOWN. No Mixtral, GPU, measured-hardware, calibration, DSE, performance, break-even or production-scale claim is established.
authorized_next_stage: Phase 6 CPU-only remediation, a fresh immutable sealed run and a new independent three-role same-hash review only.
